title: UPSSSC Junior Engineer JE (Mechanical) Recruitment 2026
qualification: Post Name Eligibility Criteria Technical Assistant (Mechanical) (Special Selection) Candidates must have a three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from the Board of Technical Education, Uttar Pradesh, or an equivalent Diploma in Mechanical Engineering recognized by the Government. Preference will be given to candidates who have served in the Territorial Army for a minimum period of two years or have obtained a ‘B’ Certificate from the National Cadet Corps (NCC). Operator Machine Candidates must have passed the Intermediate examination from the Board of Secondary Education, Uttar Pradesh, or an equivalent examination recognized by the Government. They must also possess a three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Mechanical Maintenance Trade from a government institution or an institution recognized by the Government. Assistant Storekeeper Diploma in Automobile Engineering or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized polytechnic institute is required. Mechanic 3-year Diploma in Automobile Engineering or Mechanical Engineering (Automobile) from a recognized polytechnic institute. Additional Engineer (Mechanical) – Ordinary and Special Selection Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a university established by law in India, a diploma awarded by the Board of Technical Education, Uttar Pradesh, or a diploma in Mechanical Engineering awarded by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). Assistant District Panchayat Raj Officer (Technical) A degree in Science from a recognized institution or university. Junior Engineer (Mechanical) Candidates must have passed the High School Examination or an equivalent examination recognized by the Uttar Pradesh Board of High School and Intermediate Education and possess a three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from the Board of Technical Education, Uttar Pradesh, or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government. Preference will be given to candidates who have completed at least two years of service in the Territorial Army or obtained a ‘B’ Certificate from the National Cadet Corps (NCC).
